cd827ea5e8991568.description: About AbbVie AbbVie is dedicated to discovering and delivering innovative medicines and solutions to address serious health issues and future medical challenges. The company aims to make a significant impact on people's lives across therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology, and neuroscience, in addition to its Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. The Role of Senior Product Specialist, Immunology AbbVie is seeking a Senior Product Specialist, Immunology to join its team in Dammam. This full-time position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience and focuses on driving sales performance and achieving strategic objectives within the immunology therapeutic area. Key Responsibilities Achieve or exceed sales performance, brand Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), financial targets, and marketing objectives. Develop pre-call plans using SMART objectives and conduct post-call evaluations to continuously enhance sales performance. Effectively manage objections, misunderstandings, and concerns, consistently securing logical calls to action to close sales calls. Proactively address customer needs, expectations, and challenges to build trusted relationships and achieve mutually beneficial agreements. Execute a call plan that meets established metrics and optimizes coverage and frequency to key customers, maximizing access and sales opportunities. Continuously develop understanding of customer needs, market landscape, competitors, market dynamics, accounts, disease states, product knowledge, clinical data, and sales expertise. Share market intelligence with in-field teams, brand teams, and sales managers to ensure alignment, anticipate environmental changes, and optimize brand strategy. Differentiate AbbVie’s value proposition with assigned healthcare providers and identify, develop, and maintain relationships with disease state experts and advocates to maximize brand performance. Required Experience A minimum of 2 to 5 years of relevant professional experience is required for this role. Work Environment and Culture AbbVie operates as an equal opportunity employer, committed to integrity, driving innovation, transforming lives, and serving the community. The company values diversity and is dedicated to providing equal opportunities for all employees and applicants.

cd370fa338b81c2f.description: About the Role Michael Page is seeking a Legal Manager to join a growing Saudi-based organization in Riyadh. This is a full-time, standalone legal leadership position, reporting directly to the CEO. The role offers broad exposure across commercial legal matters, corporate governance, board secretariat responsibilities, regulatory compliance, and licensing activities within a regulated environment. Role Context and Impact The successful candidate will serve as the organization's primary legal adviser, playing a key role in supporting the business's growth, governance, and regulatory obligations. This position involves establishing legal frameworks, processes, and best practices to support the company's long-term objectives during a phase of expansion. Key Responsibilities Draft, review, and negotiate commercial contracts, agreements, MOUs, NDAs, and other legal documentation. Manage company licenses, permits, registrations, and regulatory requirements, ensuring ongoing compliance. Support and coordinate Board and Committee activities, including agendas, resolutions, minutes, and governance documentation. Prepare and maintain corporate records, powers of attorney, corporate filings, and statutory documentation. Provide practical legal advice to management on commercial, operational, governance, and regulatory matters. Manage relationships with external legal counsel and oversee specialist legal matters when required. Identify and mitigate legal risks while developing legal processes, repositories, policies, and governance frameworks. Qualifications and Requirements 5-10 years of relevant legal experience. Saudi National. Career Development This role offers direct exposure to the CEO and executive leadership team, providing significant autonomy and visibility across the organization. It presents an opportunity to shape legal frameworks, policies, and business processes from the ground up, with long-term career progression within an expanding and evolving business.

cd4a61e8a48f0922.description: About the Role Eram Talent is seeking an experienced Administrative Assistant (Executive Support) to provide comprehensive administrative support to senior leadership, specifically the Vice President's Office. This full-time role focuses on ensuring the smooth coordination of meetings, schedules, documentation, and daily administrative activities within a professional environment in Saudi Arabia. Role Overview The successful candidate will be responsible for supporting senior executives, organizing leadership meetings, preparing essential meeting materials, and managing confidential documents. The position requires a proactive approach to office coordination and a strong ability to follow up on action items to ensure timely completion. Key Responsibilities Provide administrative and executive support to senior management and the Vice President's Office. Manage calendars, appointments, schedules, and meeting arrangements. Organize and coordinate senior management and leadership meetings. Prepare meeting agendas, presentations, reports, and supporting documents. Attend meetings, take minutes, prepare meeting notes, and circulate action points. Follow up with department heads and stakeholders to ensure completion of assigned actions. Handle official correspondence, emails, reports, and confidential documents. Coordinate internal and external communications with senior stakeholders. Arrange business travel, appointments, workshops, and official events. Maintain organized records, files, and administrative documentation. Support special assignments and other administrative activities as required. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Office Administration, or a related field. Minimum of 3–5 years of relevant administrative or executive support experience. Previous experience as an Executive Assistant, Personal Assistant, Senior Administrative Assistant, or Management Assistant. Experience supporting Vice Presidents, Directors, CEOs, or other senior executives is highly preferred. Hands-on experience coordinating leadership meetings and preparing meeting documentation. Experience preparing meeting minutes, presentations, reports, and official correspondence. Experience coordinating with multiple departments and senior stakeholders. Application Process Candidates meeting the specified requirements are encouraged to apply for this full-time position. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

cd4d88b0ffef5161.description: About the Role شركة رفل العقارية is seeking a Real Estate Sales Specialist to join our team in Riyadh. This full-time role is central to achieving the company's sales targets by engaging with potential clients, closing sales and leasing deals, and fostering long-term client relationships. Key Responsibilities Promote and sell residential and commercial units within the company's projects. Communicate with potential clients to understand their needs and provide suitable real estate solutions. Organize and conduct field tours for clients at sites and projects. Prepare marketing proposals and contracts, and finalize sales procedures in coordination with the legal department. Update the client database regularly via the CRM system. Achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets. Prepare weekly and monthly sales reports and submit them to management. Monitor market trends and competitor prices, providing recommendations. Represent the company at real estate events and exhibitions. Coordinate with marketing, legal, and financial departments to ensure smooth sales processes. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree, preferably in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field. At least 2-5 years of experience in real estate sales. Required Skills Strong negotiation, persuasion, and relationship-building skills. Familiarity with the legal and procedural aspects of real estate sales and purchases. Proficiency in using CRM systems and Microsoft Office Suite. Commitment to deadlines, professional communication, and appearance. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, where you will work as part of a dedicated sales team, collaborating with various internal departments to achieve company objectives. Application Process We invite qualified candidates to apply for this role to contribute to our sales success.

cd62a1c673682b0c.description: About the Role Eram Talent is seeking a Healthcare Finance & Revenue Cycle Specialist to manage financial activities and healthcare insurance claim processes in Saudi Arabia. This full-time role requires strong experience in both Finance/Accounting and Medical Insurance/Healthcare Revenue Cycle Management (RCM). Role Overview The specialist will be responsible for financial analysis, budgeting, invoice and quotation validation, insurance claims, reconciliation, and reporting. The position involves coordination with healthcare operators, insurance companies, and internal Finance teams to ensure efficient financial operations and revenue cycle performance. Key Responsibilities Review and validate invoices and quotations for accuracy and compliance. Monitor budgets, expenditures, and financial performance. Support annual budget preparation, monitoring, and control. Prepare monthly financial analysis and variance reports. Identify financial discrepancies, risks, and opportunities for improvement. Oversee monthly medical insurance claim submission processes. Review and validate insurance claims for accuracy, completeness, and compliance. Monitor claim rejections and denials and support corrective actions. Perform insurance claim reconciliation and resolve discrepancies with operators and insurers. Monitor payment and collection processes and ensure proper documentation. Coordinate with insurance companies and healthcare operators regarding claims and payment issues. Prepare financial and insurance/RCM performance reports for management. Monitor financial and revenue cycle Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Analyze trends and identify opportunities to improve revenue cycle performance. Support audits and ensure compliance with applicable policies and requirements. Act as a key contact for Finance and medical insurance/claim-related matters. Coordinate closely with KAUST Health, Finance, healthcare operators, and insurance companies. Participate in reconciliation meetings and follow up on outstanding issues. Support management with financial and operational analysis. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in Finance/Accounting and Medical Insurance/Healthcare Revenue Cycle Management. Demonstrated ability to oversee financial activities and manage healthcare insurance claim processes. Strong analytical skills for financial analysis, budgeting, and reporting. Experience in reconciling insurance claims and resolving discrepancies. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified requirements are encouraged to apply for this full-time position.

cd6c2ac957a535ce.description: About ************ ********** is a global company specializing in Objective AI (ODAI), which combines fundamental physics with AI to characterize the physical world and provide high-value decision recommendations. The company's technology offers role-specific co-pilots for mine and plant operations, or sends recommendations directly to control systems, advancing operations towards autonomy. Headquartered in Cambridge, UK, ********** operates remotely with regional hubs in Chile, Australia, and Ireland, and has a growing presence in Saudi Arabia, a key region for mining development under Vision 2030. The Role: Mining Technology Lead – Plant (Lead Metallurgist, Industrial AI) ************ is seeking a Mining Technology Lead – Plant to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on leading the implementation, commissioning, and value delivery across customer plant sites. The successful candidate will serve as the metallurgical authority for various circuits, ensuring that the company's AI accurately reflects plant behavior and delivers verifiable value. Key Responsibilities Own the implementation, commissioning, and value delivery across all Plant customer sites. Act as the metallurgical authority for crushing, grinding, flotation, leaching, thickening, and other circuits to ensure AI accurately reflects plant behavior. Prove delivered value with sound, data-driven baselines that customers trust, and use these to secure renewals. Lead, coach, and develop a team of Mining Technology Engineers across multiple sites. Collaborate with agentic AI engineers to automate site rollout and service work. Integrate site feedback into the product roadmap. Support account teams in acquiring more sites and products with existing customers. Work Environment and Location This role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. ************ operates as a remote-first company with flexible working arrangements. The position requires the ability to obtain the right to work in Saudi Arabia, and both Saudi nationals and expatriates are encouraged to apply. Onboarding may include a period at the company's UK headquarters. Compensation and Benefits ************ offers a competitive salary and benefits package, benchmarked to the candidate's location. The role provides direct ownership of a market within a growing industrial AI company and an opportunity to shape the company's presence in Saudi Arabia. Application Process The hiring process typically involves a 30-minute call with the People team, a technical interview, a short test project presentation, a conversation with the Chief Customer Officer and Chief Growth Officer, and reference checks. The company aims to complete the hiring process in approximately 8 weeks and provides updates at each stage. ************ is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity; adjustments can be made during the process if needed.

cd900dc7f80108e4.description: About the Role Acwa is seeking a Business Integration Manager Water to join its team in Makkah, with locations in Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role focuses on integrating Water assets into a unified, decision-ready portfolio by connecting performance, governance, stakeholder, risk, compliance, and cost information across Project Companies and enabling functions. The role provides consolidated reporting and consistent narratives to KSA leadership, standardizes governance workflows, and strengthens strategic stakeholder engagement. Key Accountabilities Consolidate Water asset performance into standardized reports and dashboards for various stakeholders, including KSA leadership and committees. Normalize and compare performance indicators across Project Companies and technologies to create a consistent portfolio view. Develop and maintain Water portfolio dashboards, reporting templates, and management narratives. Identify performance deviations and cross-asset issues, coordinate root-cause analysis, and escalate matters requiring leadership intervention. Standardize board and committee structures, calendars, and preparation guidelines across Water Project Companies. Coordinate the preparation, quality review, and timely circulation of governance materials. Track strategic board and committee decisions, commitments, and action items through closure. Maintain stakeholder maps and engagement plans for Water-sector Offtakers, authorities, EPC contractors, and other key partners. Coordinate internal alignment and unified communication before strategic engagements and high-level meetings. Organize periodic strategic business reviews and high-level meetings, including agenda and follow-up actions. Consolidate Water portfolio audit, risk, and compliance information, providing early visibility of systemic exposure. Track mitigation actions and closure of audit and compliance findings, escalating overdue items. Track Service Level Agreement execution, fees, cost allocation, and recovery from SPVs, escalating leakage or delayed recovery. Support resource allocation to improve utilization, cost efficiency, and continuity of Project Company roles. Support implementation of the Business Integration operating model, reporting cadence, and governance standards. Monitor Business Integration KPIs, including reporting timeliness, standard-template adoption, and action closure. Policies, Processes, and Continuous Improvement The role involves implementing approved policies, processes, and procedures, ensuring work adheres to required governance, quality, and confidentiality standards. This includes maintaining accurate records, trackers, and source data with clear version control. The manager will identify and implement improvements to reporting, governance, stakeholder coordination, risk visibility, cost recovery, and resource-management processes, promoting technology-enabled and standardized ways of working across the Water portfolio. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in business integration, portfolio management, or a related field within the water sector. A strong understanding of performance reporting, governance frameworks, stakeholder management, risk assessment, and compliance is essential. Communication and Working Relationships This role requires extensive internal collaboration with the Water Assets Head, Head of Business Integration, KSA CEO, Project Companies, EMOs, Finance, P&C, HSSE, Legal, Contracts, Risk, Audit, Compliance, Business Development, Operations, Digital, and Corporate Communications. External relationships include shareholders, Offtakers, government authorities, EPC contractors, OEMs, key suppliers, lenders, advisors, consultants, and strategic partners. Additional Responsibilities The Business Integration Manager Water will perform other related duties or assignments as directed by the line manager within the scope of the role.

cda809fc695f136b.description: About Müller's Solutions Müller's Solutions is a technology and consulting company that provides IT solutions and professional services across the EMEA region. The company supports organizations with digital transformation, IT modernization, and the delivery of high-quality technology services. Service Delivery Manager Role Müller's Solutions is seeking an experienced Service Delivery Manager to work in Saudi Arabia. This full-time role requires mandatory experience within the Airline/Aviation industry. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing end-to-end service delivery, maintaining client relationships, ensuring compliance with SLAs and KPIs, and coordinating technical and operational teams to deliver IT services. Key Responsibilities Manage end-to-end IT service delivery for clients in the airline/aviation sector. Serve as the primary point of contact for clients and key stakeholders. Ensure service delivery adheres to agreed SLAs, KPIs, and quality standards. Monitor service performance and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. Coordinate with technical, operational, and support teams to resolve service issues. Manage incidents, problems, escalations, and service requests. Prepare and present service performance reports to clients and management. Conduct regular service reviews and stakeholder meetings. Identify risks and implement corrective and preventive actions. Ensure effective communication between business stakeholders and technical teams. Support ITIL-based service management processes and best practices. Manage escalations and ensure timely resolution of critical issues. Required Qualifications and Experience Mandatory: Proven experience working within the Airline/Aviation industry. Candidates without relevant Airline/Aviation experience will not be considered. 5-10 years of proven experience as a Service Delivery Manager or in a similar IT service management role. Strong knowledge of IT Service Management / ITIL principles. Experience managing SLAs, KPIs, service performance, and escalations. Strong stakeholder and client management skills. Experience coordinating cross-functional technical and operational teams. Excellent communication and presentation skills. Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Preferred Qualifications ITIL certification. Experience with airline IT systems, aviation technology, or airport environments. Experience managing large-scale IT services or enterprise clients. Experience working with international or EMEA-based clients.

cdce3af7c7569b07.description: About the Role Eram Talent is seeking a Mechatronics Engineer to join the Facility Maintenance team within Mechanical Services Shops in Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on ensuring the reliability, maintainability, and safe operation of integrated mechanical, electrical, control, robotic, and automated systems across the facility. The successful candidate will lead troubleshooting efforts, preventive and predictive maintenance, equipment upgrades, and lifecycle management for facility equipment and production machinery. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement maintenance strategies for facility equipment, including CNC machines, balancing machines, robots, furnaces, test stands, pumps, compressors, conveyors, drives, sensors, and hydraulic and pneumatic systems. Troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, servo, PLC, motion-control, hydraulic, pneumatic, and communication faults using drawings, diagnostic software, measurements, and failure evidence. Establish asset criticality, preventive and predictive maintenance tasks, lubrication, alignment, vibration monitoring, thermography, calibration, spare-parts requirements, and condition-monitoring programs. Engineer and validate equipment upgrades, safety circuits, drives, sensors, automation changes, and OEM retrofits through controlled design, testing, and change management. Maintain CMMS records, maintenance plans, procedures, breakdown reports, KPIs, obsolescence plans, contractor controls, technical documentation, and training for maintenance personnel. Ensure maintenance activities comply with applicable safety regulations, operational procedures, equipment standards, and quality requirements. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Mechatronics, Mechanical, Electrical, Automation, or Electromechanical Engineering from a recognized and approved program. A minimum of 12 years of industrial or facility maintenance experience is required. At least 7 years of this experience must be specifically supporting CNC machines, balancing machines, or integrated mechatronic systems. Required Skills and Knowledge Strong hands-on knowledge of machine mechanics, bearings, alignment, hydraulics, pneumatics, motors, drives, servos, PLCs, sensors, robots, and safety interlocks. Experience with OEM diagnostic tools, electrical and mechanical drawings, precision measurement, condition monitoring, and structured root cause analysis. Demonstrated ability to develop preventive maintenance plans, manage critical spare parts, execute equipment upgrades, and support safe commissioning. Work Environment This role is part of the Facility Maintenance team within Mechanical Services Shops, focusing on maintaining facility infrastructure, industrial machinery, and supporting equipment to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient operations. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified qualifications and experience are encouraged to apply for this Mechatronics Engineer position.

cd033340076b5ec5.description: About the Role Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking an Associate Director - Destination Partnerships. This full-time role is responsible for developing and managing Qiddiya’s commercial partnerships ecosystem and distribution network. The position focuses on driving sustainable revenue through strategic partnerships, travel trade relationships, online and offline distribution channels, and tourism activations. Key Responsibilities Develop and lead the commercial partnerships and distribution strategy in alignment with Qiddiya’s objectives, national tourism priorities, and Vision 2030. Establish multi-year commercial targets, partnership priorities, and pipeline development plans. Identify, negotiate, and secure high-value partnerships with various travel and hospitality entities. Build and manage relationships with key local, regional, and international partners. Oversee partnership agreements, memoranda of understanding, and commercial contracts. Lead the development and optimization of Qiddiya’s business-to-business and business-to-consumer distribution network. Manage the commercial revenue and budget for the Partnerships and Distribution function. Lead and develop a team of Senior Managers, Managers, and Specialists across Partnerships and Distribution. Act as the main commercial representative for partnership and distribution matters with relevant government entities, tourism authorities, and Qiddiya stakeholders. Represent Qiddiya at major domestic and international travel trade exhibitions and industry events. Commercial Strategy and Leadership This role involves developing innovative commercial models, including revenue-sharing arrangements, guaranteed inventory agreements, joint marketing contributions, and partner incentive programmes. The Associate Director will provide senior leadership with regular updates on commercial performance, market developments, risks, and opportunities, translating the commercial strategy into clear plans for the Partnerships and Distribution teams. Distribution Network Development Responsibilities include overseeing relationships and connectivity with online travel agencies and global distribution systems such as Amadeus, Sabre, and Galileo. The role will develop channel pricing, inventory management, rate parity, and commission policies, and lead the development of a trade partner portal. Collaboration with Digital and Technology teams is essential to improve customer journeys and conversion across digital distribution channels. Revenue and Commercial Performance The Associate Director will establish commercial dashboards to monitor partnership pipeline value, deal progress, conversion rates, channel performance, and revenue against targets. This includes implementing structured pipeline governance, conducting market and competitor benchmarking, and identifying revenue risks and new commercial opportunities. Qualifications and Requirements Minimum of 12 years of progressive commercial experience within tourism, hospitality, destination management, travel trade, or a related industry. At least five years of experience in a senior leadership position.

cd38235191dc8f0d.description: About Red Sea Global Red Sea Global (RSG) is a company focused on regenerative tourism, contributing to Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030. The organization is committed to sustainable practices and aims to lead global efforts in responsible tourism development. Role Overview The Associate Director - Digital Marketing will be based primarily at the Red Sea Global HQ. This full-time position requires 12-15 years of experience and may involve travel as needed. The role focuses on leading and optimizing digital marketing efforts for both corporate and destination brands, ensuring alignment with business objectives. Key Duties Lead, grow, and optimize all Residential Marketing corporate and destination Digital Channels and Platforms. Develop engaging content and execute digital campaigns to meet or exceed specific business objectives within defined timeframes and budgets. Collaborate with PR & Communications, Marketing, Events, Trade, and Smart Destination teams to ensure consistent messaging, branding, audience targeting, engagements, and conversions across all corporate and destination digital touchpoints. Responsibilities Direct the implementation of the annual business plan and targets for digital marketing. Implement the strategic agenda of the Digital Marketing function to achieve the RSG vision, mission, and business objectives. Translate the Digital Marketing strategy for both the corporate brand (RSG) and the destination brand into operational business plans for Social Media Channels, Website Platforms, Content Creation, and digital Marketing Campaigns. Monitor the performance and execution of these plans to achieve functional objectives and deliver the company’s strategy. Play a leading role in the Tourism Services component of RSG’s smart destination strategy. Experience Required Candidates should possess 12-15 years of relevant experience in digital marketing roles. Work Environment This is a full-time position based at the Red Sea Global Headquarters. The role may require occasional travel as business needs dictate.

cd32d8124efb1429.description: About KEO International Consultants KEO International Consultants is a creative enterprise known for its innovation in planning, design, and project delivery across built and natural environments. With over 60 years of experience, KEO has contributed to numerous ambitious projects globally. The firm is recognized by ENR as a Top 225 International Design Firm and a Top 20 International PM/CM Firm, and by World Architecture as the 51st largest global architecture firm and the #1 Firm in the Middle East Region in their 2024 WA100 Survey. The Role: Senior Architecture Engineer KEO International Consultants is seeking a Senior Architecture Engineer to join its team. This full-time role involves architectural design review, technical coordination, and construction supervision for high-end developments, with a focus on luxury hotels and 5-star hospitality projects. The position requires a professional with extensive experience in architectural detailing, construction documentation, and compliance with international and local standards. Key Responsibilities Conduct architectural design review, technical coordination, and construction supervision for luxury hotels, 5-star hospitality, or high-end developments. Apply advanced knowledge of architectural detailing, construction documentation, specifications, and design compliance. Demonstrate a strong understanding of luxury finishes, including natural stone, marble, timber, bespoke joinery, decorative metalwork, specialist wall and floor finishes, and premium materials. Review architectural drawings, shop drawings, material submittals, technical submissions, and specifications. Coordinate architectural works with structural, MEP, interior design, façade, lighting, and specialist systems. Review material samples, mock-ups, benchmark rooms, and sample boards to ensure compliance with approved design intent and quality standards. Possess strong knowledge of façade systems, glazing, waterproofing, architectural finishes, and building envelope interfaces. Monitor architectural workmanship, installation methodologies, finishing details, and quality standards. Manage RFIs, technical queries, design changes, design discrepancies, and constructability issues. Maintain knowledge of applicable international standards, the Saudi Building Code, and relevant authority requirements. Utilize proficiency in AutoCAD, Revit, and BIM coordination tools. Qualifications and Experience A Bachelor’s degree in Architecture is required. Association of License Architect. A minimum of 15 years of relevant experience, with at least 5 years in the GCC region. Work Environment and Benefits KEO fosters a supportive environment that promotes professional development through internal global mobility and career advancement. The company culture supports health and well-being with on-demand counseling services and regular workplace clinics. Employees are invited to participate in community events such as sports days, fun-runs, in-house sports teams, and beach clean-ups. In addition to a competitive package and benefits, KEO offers policies that include hybrid working arrangements, individual athletic sponsorship, study assistance sponsorship, and employee referral rewards.

cd55f20c78e72db6.description: About the Role Standard Chartered is seeking a Relationship Manager, Priority to join the team. This permanent position focuses on customer sales and service, requiring 0-1 years of experience. The role involves managing customer relationships, delivering superior service, and expanding customer portfolios within the Priority Banking segment. Key Responsibilities Understand, acknowledge, and comply with individual accountabilities and responsibilities as per local laws, regulations, and SCB internal policies. Ensure and intensify internal controls by staying informed on developments in applicable local laws and regulations. Perform duties diligently to avoid legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank. Deliver allocated performance targets across various product value streams. Maintain customer relationships and provide superior customer service to meet customer needs. Enhance bank-customer relationships by expanding existing customers’ portfolio holdings. Actively participate in marketing and promotional activities to acquire new-to-bank (NTB) customers and cross-sell to existing customers. Proactively engage with Personal Clients identified as affluent and advise them on complex investment needs. Implement and comply with AML requirements while performing duties. Ensure compliance with the Management Manual, Operating Manuals, and the Bank’s knowledge of various products. Learn and understand all relevant regulations and internal Risk & Compliance policies and procedures. Stay updated on events within the financial industry. Participate actively in training programs, meetings, and briefings, applying acquired skills and knowledge to daily work. Ensure timely management of customer complaints. Governance and Conduct Display exemplary conduct aligned with the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct. Take personal responsibility for embedding high standards of ethics, regulatory, and business conduct across Standard Chartered Bank. Understand and ensure compliance with all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines, and the Group Code of Conduct. Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate, and resolve risk, conduct, and compliance matters. Risk Management The role involves identifying, assessing, monitoring, controlling, and mitigating risks to the Group. This includes an awareness and understanding of the main risks facing the Group and the individual's role in managing them. Responsibilities also cover the execution and supervision of all aspects under the Risk Management Framework. Employee Development and Culture Standard Chartered fosters a continuous learning culture, supporting employee growth through reskilling and upskilling opportunities, with access to physical, virtual, and digital learning resources. The organization is inclusive and values-driven, embracing diversity across teams, business functions, and geographies to ensure all employees feel respected and can realize their full potential. Compensation and Benefits In line with its Fair Pay Charter, Standard Chartered offers a competitive salary and benefits package designed to support mental, physical, financial, and social wellbeing. This includes core bank funding for retirement savings, medical, and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in certain locations. Time-off provisions include annual leave, parental/maternity leave (20 weeks), sabbatical (up to 12 months), and volunteering leave (3 days), with a minimum global standard of 30 days for annual and public holidays combined. Flexible working options are available, based on home and office locations, with flexible working patterns. Proactive wellbeing support is provided through platforms like Unmind, development courses for resilience, a global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders, and various self-help toolkits.

cd6c0d0987ab9b97.description: About the Role SLB is seeking a Field HSE Specialist to join their team in Dhahran. This full-time role is responsible for supporting local managers in establishing and continuously improving the quality and health, safety, and environment (HSE) culture at the worksite. The specialist will develop awareness and ensure quality and HSE compliance are integrated into Line Management responsibilities and objectives. Key Responsibilities Assist management and support functions in implementing and improving Quality and HSE Management Systems, and defining quality and HSE objectives. Liaise with customers, subcontractors, and agencies regarding quality and HSE matters. Assess local risks, then generate and implement local policies and plans. Set up controls to verify implementation and maintain related records. Conduct review meetings to assess the effectiveness of Quality and HSE Management Systems and identify required improvements. Coordinate and participate in the screening and training of personnel, including subcontractors. Stay informed of new developments or policies related to quality and HSE, and inform management accordingly. Ensure that HSE documentation is readily available on site. Advise management on compliance with local and national HSE regulations of the host country. Participate in quality and HSE audits and investigations of major failures and accidents. Develop and maintain a high level of awareness among all personnel through communication, training, and ensuring employee participation in quality and HSE incident prevention and reporting activities. Required Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in HSE, Environmental Science, Engineering, or a related field. 3–5+ years of experience in HSE roles, preferably within the oil & gas or industrial environment. Knowledge of HSE management systems (ISO 45001, ISO 14001). Familiarity with local and international HSE regulations and standards. Experience in risk assessment, audits, and incident investigation. Relevant HSE certifications (*, NEBOSH, IOSH) are preferred. Skills and Abilities Strong communication and training skills. Ability to promote a safety culture and ensure compliance on site. Work Type This is a full-time position.

cd98b638b80dea3f.description: About the Role Parsons Corporation is seeking a Senior Risk Manager to join their team in Makkah. This full-time position involves managing a comprehensive risk picture across four distinct business streams, ensuring a unified approach to risk identification, assessment, and mitigation. The successful candidate will report to the Governance, Risk and Compliance Lead and will be part of an integrated project management consultancy (PMC) team. Role Context and Scope The Senior Risk Manager will operate within the Governance, Risk and Compliance function, serving a master developer in Makkah. The role encompasses oversight for four critical business streams: the Al Mashaer upgrade projects, operations and maintenance with Hajj seasonal readiness, long-term investment projects, and short-term build-operate-transfer (BOT) projects that require full operational readiness for the Hajj season. This position is subject to client approval. Key Responsibilities Manage the consolidated risk register and implement a single scoring method across all four business streams. Facilitate risk workshops to identify and assess potential risks. Maintain an up-to-date decision log for all risk-related matters. Escalate risks and issues in accordance with established risk and escalation procedures. Provide essential risk data for the integrated dashboard and contribute to improvement program reviews. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in risk management or a related field. Demonstrated analytical, organized, and accurate work approach. Ability to collaborate effectively across various disciplines. Required Skills Clear communication skills, both in written form and during meetings. Proven ability to deliver results to deadlines, even under pressure. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, within a dynamic integrated project management consultancy team. The role requires close collaboration with various stakeholders and functions to ensure effective risk management across critical projects and operations.

cde8284103097c37.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة عبدالعزيز الجاسر التجارية القابضة عن أخصائي جودة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تصميم وتطبيق معايير الجودة، وتقييم رضا العملاء، وتطوير أنظمة تدقيق الجودة لضمان تقديم خدمات عالية المستوى. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة وتحليل وإعداد وتصميم أدلة ونماذج إدارة الجودة، وتحديد وتطوير مواصفات ومعايير ومؤشرات لمختلف العمليات والمخرجات. المساهمة في تطوير معايير ومواصفات الجودة المطلوبة للمبادرات والبرامج والمخرجات قيد التطوير، بما يتوافق مع خطط العمل الموضوعة. إعداد وتطوير استبيانات قياس مستوى رضا العملاء عن جودة الخدمات والعمليات والإجراءات، وتوثيق وتحليل توصياتهم التحسينية. تطوير أنظمة وإجراءات ونماذج تدقيق الجودة، والمشاركة في وضع خطط التدقيق الدوري والسنوي، وتنفيذ عمليات ضبط وتدقيق الجودة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالجودة، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الجودة أو ما يعادله. القدرة على تصميم أدلة ونماذج إدارة الجودة. فهم جيد لمعايير ومواصفات الجودة. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات تحليلية قوية لدراسة البيانات وتقييم الأداء. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. مهارات تواصل فعالة لعرض التوصيات وتوضيحها. الالتزام بالدقة والتفاصيل في جميع المهام. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. يعمل أخصائي الجودة ضمن فريق متخصص لضمان تطبيق أفضل ممارسات الجودة في جميع عمليات الشركة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن. تشجع الشركة المتقدمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات على تقديم طلباتهم.

Oversee asset records, condition assessments, risk-based maintenance and renewal planning for landscapes, trees, irrigation and associated park assets. Horticulture, arboriculture and irrigation: Own technical performance across plant establishment, tree risk, soil health, pest treatment, irrigation efficiency and climate resilience. Coordinate water-demand forecasts, supply requirements and contingency arrangements with Utilities. Park standards and public experience: Define availability, visitor-service and accessibility requirements, coordinating inspections, temporary closures, permitted activities and event reinstatement with the responsible teams. Operational readiness and handover: Set operational design and readiness requirements, assess maintainability and establishment performance, and provide evidence-based adoption recommendations supported by commissioning records, maintenance plans, warranties and clear defect responsibilities. Demonstrated experience managing operating budgets, multidisciplinary teams and outsourced service providers, including mobilising assets into operation. The ability to present investment priorities and material risks to executive stakeholders, supported by sound commercial judgement, technical credibility and evidence-based decision-making. An asset-owner mindset, strong stakeholder influence and clear accountability, with the ability to lead calmly through incidents and ambiguity

cd0be92386a78752.description: About the Role Sheraton Hotels & Resorts is seeking a Life Guard to join their team in Dammam, Eastern region. This full-time role is responsible for ensuring the safety of swimmers and maintaining a comfortable environment for guests within the designated swimming area. The position requires 0-1 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Monitor the designated swimming area for dangerous situations, unusual activities, and swimmers in distress. Utilize appropriate rescue techniques when swimmers require assistance. Promote and enforce recreational facility rules and regulations. Identify situations where guests cannot safely participate in an activity and report to a supervisor/manager. Provide assistance to injured guests until emergency medical services arrive. Maintain a joyful and comfortable environment for all guests. Perform tasks such as taking, folding, and stacking towels according to company procedures. Wash, scrub, and clean the pool deck area. Operational Duties and Physical Requirements Comply with all company safety policies and procedures; report maintenance issues, safety hazards, accidents, or injuries; complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are neat and professional. Maintain the privacy of company property information and protect company assets. Support co-workers and treat them with dignity and respect; contribute to team goals. Meet quality assurance expectations and standards. Stand, sit, or walk for extended periods or for the entire work shift; move at a speed required to respond to work situations (*, running, walking, jogging). Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines to identify defects. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of various sizes and weights, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting at the waist, crawling, and leaning. Move on inclined, uneven, or slippery surfaces and stairs; climb up and down ladders and service ramps. Greet and acknowledge all guests according to company standards; communicate professionally and answer phone calls appropriately. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by supervisors. Qualifications and Requirements High school diploma or equivalent General Educational Development (GED) certificate. No related work experience required. No supervisory experience required. cd0aad7e13a2f4f9.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الوردي عن أخصائي عمليات موارد بشرية للانضمام إلى فريقها في المبرز، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور على إدارة العمليات اليومية للموارد البشرية، بدءًا من التوظيف وحتى إدارة الأداء والامتثال القانوني. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الموارد البشرية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية نشر الإعلانات الوظيفية، فرز السير الذاتية، إجراء المقابلات، واختيار الكفاءات المناسبة، بالإضافة إلى تجهيز عقود العمل. تنفيذ برامج تهيئة الموظفين الجدد وتعريفهم بسياسات الشركة وثقافتها، وإدارة إجراءات إنهاء الخدمات للمغادرين. التنسيق لإعداد كشوف الرواتب، متابعة الحضور والانصراف، وإدارة المزايا مثل التأمين الصحي والبدلات. تطبيق نماذج ومعايير تقييم أداء الموظفين بشكل دوري ومساعدة المدراء في تطوير الكفاءات. تحديد الاحتياجات التدريبية للموظفين وتنظيم ورش العمل والبرامج التطويرية. استقبال شكاوى واستفسارات الموظفين، والعمل على حل الخلافات وتطبيق اللوائح التأديبية بعدالة. متابعة الالتزام بقوانين العمل والأنظمة المعمول بها، وتحديث السجلات الوظيفية بانتظام عبر أنظمة إدارة الموارد البشرية (HRIS). إدارة شؤون الموظفين يتولى أخصائي عمليات الموارد البشرية مسؤولية إدارة ملفات الموظفين، ومتابعة البيانات الشخصية والوظيفية، بالإضافة إلى توثيق الإجازات والاستقالات. يضمن هذا الدور دقة واكتمال جميع سجلات الموظفين للامتثال للسياسات الداخلية واللوائح الخارجية. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال عمليات الموارد البشرية. فهم عميق لأنظمة ولوائح العمل والقوانين المحلية ذات الصلة. القدرة على استخدام أنظمة إدارة الموارد البشرية (HRIS). بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في المبرز، المنطقة الشرقية. يعمل أخصائي عمليات الموارد البشرية ضمن فريق ديناميكي يدعم جميع أقسام الشركة لضمان بيئة عمل منظمة وفعالة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة للتقديم على هذا الدور في شركة الوردي.

cd62c90e7bb312f3.description: About setec Middle East setec Middle East is part of setec, an international multidisciplinary engineering group that delivers complex and innovative projects globally. Based in Riyadh, the Middle East team is involved in major projects and programs across Saudi Arabia, with expertise in urban planning, urban design, infrastructure, environmental services, and PMC/PMO. As activities expand within the Kingdom, setec Middle East is seeking an HR Coordinator to support HR operations in its Riyadh office. The Role of HR Coordinator The HR Coordinator will provide day-to-day support across a broad range of HR activities, working closely with the HR team and management. This full-time position is based in Riyadh and involves supporting functions from recruitment and onboarding to employee administration and HR reporting. This role is suitable for an HR professional with 2-5 years of experience looking to develop broad HR expertise within a growing, multicultural, and international engineering environment. Key Responsibilities Support the preparation of employment contracts, HR letters, certificates, and other employee documentation. Maintain accurate and up-to-date employee records and HR databases. Support onboarding and offboarding processes, including preparing documentation and coordinating new employee arrivals. Assist with leave, medical insurance, and employee benefits administration. Help ensure HR documentation and processes comply with company policies and Saudi requirements. Support recruitment activities for positions in Saudi Arabia, including coordinating interviews, communication with candidates, and job postings. Collect and prepare HR information required for payroll processing. Coordinate with relevant internal teams and external providers as needed. Support employee data updates and administrative follow-up. Assist with HR reporting, dashboards, and workforce statistics. Assist with processes related to Iqama, visas, work permits, GOSI, and medical insurance. Support the team in maintaining HR compliance with Saudi regulations and nationalization requirements. Act as a first point of contact for employees on routine HR and administrative matters. Help employees navigate HR procedures and documentation. Support internal HR communication and employee initiatives. Contribute to training and development coordination when required. Candidate Requirements 2-5 years of experience in an HR role. Demonstrated ability to support a broad range of HR activities. Understanding of HR documentation, processes, and compliance. Experience with recruitment support and employee administration. Work Environment and Impact The HR Coordinator will join a growing international engineering organization contributing to major projects across Saudi Arabia. setec Middle East is involved in significant programs linked to Saudi Arabia's transformation, including King Salman Park, Riyadh Metro, AlUla Master Plan, Diriyah Gate, and Riyadh Expo 2030. This role offers broad exposure to HR operations and the opportunity to develop experience within an international and multicultural environment.

cdb80e0fa5871e67.description: About Synechron Synechron is a global consulting firm focused on digital transformation within businesses. The company delivers digital solutions through a combination of creativity and innovative technology. Synechron's services include Artificial Intelligence, Consulting, Digital, Cloud & DevOps, Data, and Software Engineering, primarily serving financial services and technology firms. With a global workforce of over 13,950 individuals across 52 offices in 20 countries, Synechron has been recognized with multiple employer awards over 20 years. The Role: Java Solution Architect Synechron is seeking a Java Solution Architect to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position requires over 10 years of experience and involves designing and implementing enterprise and product solutions. The architect will be responsible for aligning technology strategies with business objectives and leading large-scale enterprise solution delivery. Key Responsibilities Design complex systems across application, data, process, and infrastructure domains. Align technology strategies with business objectives. Lead and deliver large-scale enterprise solutions. Mentor and guide development teams and junior architects. Conduct resource estimation and capacity planning for CPUs, GPUs, memory, storage, and network bandwidth. Required Qualifications and Skills 15+ years of extensive experience in software development and enterprise/product solutions architecture and design. Extensive experience with Java, Spring, and Spring Boot Frameworks for backend, and Angular/React for frontend. Proficiency in Kafka, RabbitMQ, Restful Microservices, SOAP, SQL, database technologies (MySQL, MongoDB, PostgreSQL), OAuth2, JWT, Spring Security, Spring Data, Docker, and Kubernetes. Expertise in SDLC processes and methodologies. In-depth knowledge of infrastructure and networking architecture. Hands-on experience with AWS cloud services, including architecture design and implementation. Experience with AI/ML technologies, frameworks, and platforms such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, AWS SageMaker, or Google AI. Strong proficiency with C4 architecture modeling, particularly at container and component levels. Deep understanding of infrastructure design, including cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), virtualization, and networking fundamentals. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a focus on scalable, maintainable, and secure architectures. Excellent communication and collaboration abilities for working across diverse teams. Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Synechron is an equal opportunity and affirmative-action employer committed to fostering an inclusive culture. The company's 'Same Difference' initiative promotes equality, diversity, and a respectful environment for all. Synechron encourages applicants from diverse backgrounds, including various races, ethnicities, religions, ages, marital statuses, genders, sexual orientations, or disabilities. Employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications.

cde50e9f10f84d66.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة أفلاء الريس للصناعة عن مراقب خدمات عامة للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى ضمان التنظيم الفعال لحركة سير الطلاب والطالبات، مما يساهم في توفير بيئة آمنة ومنظمة. هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة حديثة أو محدودة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنظيم ومراقبة حركة سير الطلاب والطالبات داخل المنشأة لضمان الانسيابية والأمان. الإشراف على تطبيق الإجراءات والتعليمات المتعلقة بحركة الأفراد. التعاون مع الأقسام الأخرى لضمان بيئة عمل متكاملة ومنظمة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق. مهارات تنظيمية جيدة والقدرة على إدارة المهام المتعددة. بيئة العمل سيعمل مراقب الخدمات العامة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة بمنطقة مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور التواجد الفعلي في الموقع لضمان الإشراف المباشر على المهام الموكلة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف. هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى شركة أفلاء الريس للصناعة والمساهمة في تنظيم بيئة العمل.

cdbe7bc9dcd6c3d9.description: About the Role Parsons Corporation is seeking a Commercial Director to manage all contractual and commercial activities for a major project. This full-time position is based in Makkah, with responsibilities extending to Jeddah. The role involves overseeing commercial performance and ensuring compliance with project objectives, requiring over 10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Manage a team of commercial, procurement, and contract staff, including subconsultants, to analyze and evaluate project finances and contracts. Ensure commercial performance against established schedules, budgets, and critical project data. Provide guidance and specialized assistance to the project team for resolving commercial and contract-related issues. Oversee the commercial performance of assigned project areas, ensuring adherence to commercial procedures and objectives. Interface with the client team, attend meetings, and provide critical project updates, reports, and presentations. Assist with key contract negotiations and modifications to achieve favorable terms and conditions for the project. Establish and lead the implementation of strategic commercial project plans. Manage the successful commercial execution of assigned projects in coordination with the Senior Project Manager. Project Management and Reporting Assist with the development of work plans and budgets. Review project proposals and work plans to determine timelines, financial objectives, and procedures. Prepare project status reports, including updated cost projections and schedules for senior management and clients. Identify changes in scope or differing conditions and secure appropriate change orders for project cost and time, if approved. Review project progress reports and contract statuses, providing guidance and recommendations for improvements. Contractual and Claims Management Advise management on strategies to limit potential claims arising from non-adherence to project contract terms. Manage the review of contractual notices of claims and provide contractual advice to project delivery teams. Oversee the preparation and maintenance of Engineer’s Instructions, contract changes, variation orders, insurance, and claims logs. Facilitate contract close-out procedures to ensure compliance with all terms and conditions prior to final payment. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in commercial and contract management roles. Demonstrated ability to manage complex contracts and commercial activities for major projects. Experience in leading and developing commercial, procurement, and contract teams. Strong negotiation skills and experience in securing favorable contract terms. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, with project responsibilities that may include Jeddah. The role involves significant interaction with client teams and senior management.

cd6a6521ed4ed7b6.description: نبذة عن الدور تعلن شركة عمان تاورز عن حاجتها لموظف صندوق محاسبة للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إدارة المعاملات النقدية والائتمانية، وضمان دقة سجلات المبيعات، وتقديم خدمة عملاء ممتازة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال ذي صلة. المهام الرئيسية يتولى موظف الصندوق المحاسبي مسؤولية تنفيذ مجموعة من المهام اليومية لضمان سير العمليات المالية بسلاسة ودقة. تشمل هذه المهام: عد وتسجيل المبالغ المالية في آلة تسجيل النقود في بداية كل وردية عمل، مع التأكد من توفر كمية كافية من العملات الصغيرة. استلام المدفوعات النقدية أو عن طريق بطاقات الائتمان أو أي طرق دفع أخرى معتمدة، ودفع المبالغ المتبقية، وتحرير الإيصالات المناسبة للعملاء. تحديث قوائم الأسعار بشكل مستمر، وحساب أسعار السلع أو الخدمات، وإعداد جداول الفواتير، وتطبيق الخصومات عند اللزوم. تسوية النقدية الواردة مع إجمالي المبيعات في نهاية الوردية، والإبلاغ عن أية اختلافات أو تسويتها وفقاً للإجراءات المتبعة. التعامل مع العملاء بأسلوب مهني وودود، وتلبية رغباتهم المتعلقة بإضافة أو حذف عناصر من قوائم الشراء. المؤهلات والخبرات لشغل هذا المنصب، يجب أن يمتلك المرشح المؤهلات والخبرات التالية: خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال ذي صلة، ويفضل أن تكون في وظيفة أمين صندوق أو ما شابهها. القدرة على التعامل مع المبالغ النقدية بدقة وسرعة. مهارات جيدة في التعامل مع العملاء وتقديم خدمة ممتازة. المهارات المطلوبة يتطلب الدور مجموعة من المهارات الأساسية لضمان الأداء الفعال: الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في التعامل مع المعاملات المالية. مهارات التواصل الفعال والقدرة على بناء علاقات إيجابية مع العملاء. القدرة على العمل تحت الضغط وإدارة الوقت بفعالية. المرونة والقدرة على التكيف مع متطلبات العمل المتغيرة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية تتطلب التفاعل المستمر مع العملاء والزملاء. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المرشحين المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم.

cd7bb0328a5b7653.description: About the Role Marriott International is seeking a Cook I to join its team in Medina. This full-time position involves preparing and cooking a variety of food items while adhering to established quality and safety standards. The role requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Prepare special meals or substitute items as required. Regulate temperatures of cooking equipment including ovens, broilers, grills, and roasters. Thaw food from freezer storage in the refrigerator. Ensure proper portioning, arrangement, and garnishing of food. Maintain accurate food logs and monitor the quality and quantity of prepared food. Communicate assistance needed during busy periods and inform the Chef of excess food items for daily specials. Inform Food & Beverage service staff of menu specials and out-of-stock items. Prepare and cook food according to recipes, quality standards, presentation standards, and food preparation checklists. Prepare cold food items. Assist management with hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, counseling, disciplining, motivating, and coaching employees, serving as a role model. Workplace Standards and Safety Adhere to all company and safety and security policies and procedures. Report maintenance needs, accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to management. Complete all required safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional. Maintain confidentiality of proprietary information and protect company assets. Guest Service and Team Collaboration Anticipate and address guests’ service needs. Communicate with others using clear and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with colleagues. Support the team in achieving common goals and respond appropriately to employee concerns. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Physical Requirements Ability to stand, sit, or walk for extended periods. Capable of reaching overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Ability to move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors. About the Team Joining the Sheraton family, part of Marriott International, means becoming a member of a global community that has fostered gathering and connection since 1937. Associates at Sheraton contribute to a sense of belonging in over 400 communities worldwide, connecting guests through engaging experiences and thoughtful service. This role offers an opportunity to deliver meaningful guest experiences within a supportive team environment.

cd868f5d05f427dc.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة سنابل الطبية عن أخصائي مبيعات مستلزمات طبية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور على تطوير وتنفيذ سياسات البيع للمستلزمات الطبية، ومتابعة الأداء، وتقييم النتائج لضمان تحقيق الأهداف المحددة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة ومتابعة تطورات السوق لتحديد وتطوير الأهداف التسويقية وطرق البيع. تقدير حجم المبيعات المتوقع وتحويل الأهداف إلى خطط بيعية قابلة للتنفيذ. اقتراح سياسات البيع ومتابعة تنفيذها، بالإضافة إلى وضع وتقييم البرامج الترويجية. التواصل الفعال مع العملاء لتحديد احتياجاتهم ومشكلاتهم. متابعة المنافسين وبرامجهم البيعية لتجنب المخاطر المحتملة في المستقبل. تقييم أداء مندوبي المبيعات ومدى تحقيق الأهداف البيعية. اقتراح الخطط والإجراءات التصحيحية لتحسين الأداء عند الضرورة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالمبيعات، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة. عرض وتوضيح هذه التقارير وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال مبيعات المستلزمات الطبية أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تحليل السوق وتحديد الفرص البيعية. مهارات تواصل ممتازة وبناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي مبيعات المستلزمات الطبية في مؤسسة سنابل الطبية بمدينة الرياض، ضمن فريق متخصص يهدف إلى تحقيق أهداف المبيعات وتطوير استراتيجيات فعالة في سوق المستلزمات الطبية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عمل مؤسسة سنابل الطبية، يرجى التقديم لهذه الفرصة في الرياض.

cd4ecb6351c973f9.description: About the Role Invenio is seeking a Senior Associate Consultant SAP Ui /Fiori to join their team in Saudi Arabia. This full-time, mid-level position is responsible for the design, development, and support of SAP UI5 and Fiori applications. The role requires hands-on experience in UI5 development and a strong understanding of SAP systems. Key Responsibilities Develop and enhance SAPUI5/Fiori applications. Perform coding, unit testing, and support integration activities. Work on assigned tasks and modules with minimal supervision. Collaborate with functional teams to understand requirements. Troubleshoot and resolve application issues and tickets. Prepare technical documentation and support testing activities. Ensure adherence to coding standards and quality guidelines. Contribute to timely and quality project delivery. General Skills and Tasks Understand client's business and technical environment. Assist project team efforts in documenting and developing solutions for client situations. Support the team in preparing and developing solution documentation for projects. Adhere to project and organization guidelines and manage administrative responsibilities effectively. Keep the manager informed of workload direction and concerns. Analyze and develop reliable solutions that produce efficient and effective outcomes. Develop a deeper understanding of SAP methodologies, tools, standards, and techniques. Assist with project documentation and demonstrate effective organizational skills with minimal supervision. Provide project team and leaders with updates on progress and difficulties, offering value-added insight for future program development. Demonstrate the ability to accomplish project assignments resulting in quality service. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 year of experience in SAP UI5 development. Strong understanding of SAP systems. Ability to work independently on assigned tasks. Work Type This is a full-time position.

cd76b7483fe209ec.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة بن لادن السعودية عن أخصائي صحة وسلامة مهنية للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الدمام. يركز هذا الدور على مراقبة وتطبيق متطلبات السلامة في المواقع، والعمل على منع الممارسات والظروف غير الآمنة لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة ومطابقة للمعايير. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ الجولات التفتيشية الدورية في مواقع العمل لضمان الالتزام بمعايير السلامة. فحص معدات الوقاية الشخصية (PPE) ومعدات السلامة الأخرى للتأكد من صلاحيتها وكفاءتها. متابعة تصاريح العمل والتأكد من استيفائها للمتطلبات والإجراءات اللازمة قبل بدء أي نشاط. الإبلاغ الفوري عن أي مخاطر محتملة أو ظروف غير آمنة يتم رصدها في الموقع. المشاركة في أنشطة التوعية بالسلامة وإجراء التحقيقات الأولية في الحوادث أو المخالفات. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الصحة والسلامة المهنية. القدرة على تطبيق ومراقبة متطلبات السلامة في بيئات العمل المختلفة. مهارات جيدة في التواصل والإبلاغ عن المخاطر. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتتطلب التواجد في مواقع العمل بالدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي الصحة والسلامة المهنية ضمن فريق متخصص، حيث يساهم في الحفاظ على بيئة عمل آمنة ومنتجة من خلال المراقبة المستمرة والالتزام بالمعايير. الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة للتقديم على هذا الدور في مجموعة بن لادن السعودية.

cd9aed16be69167f.description: About the Role Parsons Corporation is seeking a Lead Engineer – Steel Structure to join their team in Makkah, with work locations including Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role involves leading the design, analysis, coordination, and execution of steel structural engineering projects. The position requires extensive technical expertise in structural steel systems, strong leadership capabilities, and a collaborative approach to ensure successful project delivery within scope, budget, and schedule. Key Responsibilities Lead and manage steel structural engineering projects from conceptual design through detailed design, fabrication, erection, and final completion. Provide technical direction, guidance, and mentorship to structural engineers, designers, and project teams. Coordinate with project managers, architects, civil engineers, MEP disciplines, contractors, fabricators, and other stakeholders. Establish project deliverables, review requirements, and engineering priorities to support successful project execution. Monitor project progress, technical performance, deliverables, budgets, and schedules. Lead the analysis and design of structural steel systems, including buildings, industrial structures, stadiums, long-span structures, platforms, canopies, trusses, and pipe racks. Perform and review structural calculations for gravity, lateral, seismic, wind, thermal, fatigue, and other applicable loading conditions. cd9fca5009e030af.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مصرف الراجحي عن استشاري مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقه في المنطقة الشرقية، وتحديداً في مدن الدمام، الخبر، الظهران، الجبيل، الأحساء، القطيف، راس تنورة، بقيق، العملاء في تعبئة النماذج عند الحاجة. توجيه العملاء لإتمام معاملاتهم بشكل صحيح، وتعريفهم بكيفية استخدام مكائن الصرف الآلي والقنوات الإلكترونية. توجيه العملاء إلى الموظف المختص عند الضرورة. الاستجابة المستديمة للعملاء، إنشاء وتنشيط العضويات، وتحويلها لمدير العمليات. التعامل مع طلبات تغيير التوقيع وتحريك الحسابات. إدخال المطالبات المتعلقة بالصراف الآلي ونقاط البيع في النظام المخصص. استقبال مشاكل غسل الأموال وحالات الاحتيال، والإبلاغ عن المخالفات. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 1 إلى 5 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تقديم خدمة عملاء ممتازة والتعامل باحترافية. مهارات تواصل قوية وفعالة. بيئة العمل يعمل استشاري المبيعات بدوام كامل في فروع مصرف الراجحي بالمنطقة الشرقية، ضمن بيئة مصرفية ديناميكية تركز على خدمة العملاء وتحقيق الأهداف. معلومات إضافية هذا الدور متاح في عدة مدن بالمنطقة الشرقية، cdf921af1a0eee85.description: Job description Stage - Stratégie d'intégration de données plaques et de connexion aux bases de données F/H Stage 5 à 6 mois Etudiant Temps complet SAFRAN Ceramics est une filiale du groupe SAFRAN dont la mission est de développer les matériaux et les produits en composites à matrice céramique (CMC) pour les applications du groupe. L'introduction des CMC dans les moteurs d'avion est devenue une réalité et reste un enjeu majeur pour la prochaine génération de moteurs. En effet, ces matériaux ont une très bonne tenue thermomécanique aux hautes températures et une faible densité. Ils sont donc les candidats idéaux pour remplacer les métaux dans les parties chaudes des moteurs d'avions. Les différentes pièces élaborées en CMC doivent résister aux sollicitations thermomécaniques du moteur, ce qui nécessite une maîtrise du procédé d'élaboration et une connaissance fine du comportement du matériau. Pour répondre à ces exigences, des plaques en CMC sont fabriquées en vue d'en extraire des éprouvettes de caractérisation. Lors de la fabrication des plaques et la caractérisation des éprouvettes, d'importantes quantités de données sont générées. Celles-ci proviennent de différents canaux et sont centralisées dans un operational data store (ODS). Un DataWareHouse (DWH) et un DataMart (DTM) permettent ensuite successivement de filtrer et réorganiser ces données en fonction de l'utilisation souhaitée. Ces trois briques constituent la DataTech. Au cours de leur fabrication, ces plaques sont contrôlées par différents moyens non destructifs (stéréovision, tomographie, thermographie…) pour permettre de mieux les définir. Le stage s'inscrit dans ce contexte et les missions s'articuleront autour de trois axes principaux : 1/ Automatiser la récupération des données continues liées à la fabrication des plaques. La centralisation au sein d'un même référentiel spatial permettra de mettre en correspondance les informations issues des plaques et des éprouvettes. 2/ Structurer les données récupérées et les intégrer dans le flux existant (DataTech…). 3/ Générer les données de sortie et la visualisation associée. Vous serez intégré-e au sein du département matériau et serez amené-e à interagir avec différents métiers de SAFRAN CERAMICS, notamment avec les équipes de développement matériau et procédé (textiles), de Contrôle Non Destructif (CND) et de gestion de la Data. Vous pourrez vous appuyer sur les outils existants pour mener à bien son projet. Vous serez également amené-e à participer aux points d'avancement et à présenter ses résultats sous forme de rapports et de présentations. - Parlons de vous : Vous êtes étudiant-e en Master ou école d'ingénieur avec une spécialité en Data engineering. Vous avez des connaissances en programmation (Python, SQL, VBA, R) / Bases de données / Matériaux. Vous êtes rigoureuse ou rigoureux, méthodique, organisé-e et autonome, vous présentez un intérêt pour découvrir des domaines de recherche de pointe. Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

البرنامج التدريبي ومناقشة التحديات. متابعة تعبئة سجلات الحضور للمستفيدين في جميع الخدمات والبرامج التأهيلية واستكمال سجل حصر الجلسات مع الفصول. متابعة تعبئة الخطط التشغيلية للعيادات واكتمالها. جدولة زيارات لعينة عشوائية ومختلفة للتأكد من ملائمة الخطط التدريبية. التأكد من اتباع وسائل التعزيز المناسبة خلال الجلسات التدريبية. متابعة تدريب المختصين الجدد وتحديث مهام التدريب وفق الخطة التدريبية الخاصة بهم. التواصل مع مشرفي كافة الأقسام لمتابعة سير العمل وتذليل الصعوبات ورصد الملاحظات. متابعة اكتمال التقارير الفصلية (المنتصف والنهائي) لتسليمها للأقسام في الوقت المحدد وعدم تأخيرها استعداداً لإرسالها تستدعي ذلك. الالتزام بأي مهمة او متطلب من الإشراف المركزي.  مهام فصلية: التأكد من جاهزية الفصول (وسائل، أثاث، أركان، كروت، الدعم البصري... وغيرها من المتطلبات) ورفع الاحتياج للمسؤولين. إعداد بيان
